---
name: Reusable lesson candidate
about: Promote a verified project lesson into durable shared controls
labels: reusable-lesson
---

# Observation
Describe the failure, delay, regression, or improved execution pattern that was actually observed.

# Evidence
Link the issue/PR/run/test or other evidence proving the observation and the improved result.

# Failure mode
What caused unnecessary delay, risk, duplicate work, or ambiguity?

# Improved pattern
What should future agents/projects do instead?

# Proposed scope
Choose one: local / project / portfolio / control.

# Proposed propagation
Identify applicable layers: Universal Standards, project AGENTS.md, Copilot instructions, path instructions, ADR, runbook, template/prompt/skill, test/evaluation/CI/policy-as-code.

# Safety review
State why this does not weaken approval, security, review, identity, audit, release, or production-authority controls.

# Acceptance
The lesson is complete only when the canonical rule is durable, appropriate projects can inherit it, contradictory copies are avoided, and any practical machine enforcement is added.
